TASK-20260923-edaa75 is a structurally blind re-derivation whose read scope is a six-file whitelist, with a blanket ban on git history and pull-request text. Before it is dispatched the top-level session runs python3 tools/check_review_independence.py --blind-history on the exact ref it will run on, with --protected-from coordination/goals/GOAL-AUXIN-a93442/batches/BATCH-ba0b0d/batch.yaml, whose protected values are the AUXIN census values J4 must stay blind to, and also hashes every numeric token of experiments/EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d/amendments/AMD-20260923-d1d10.yaml against the same digests. TASK-20260923-5a2cbc carries review_required true. Its three reviews depend on it and on its snapshot TASK-20260923-5ff07e, and are archived directly by the ledger archive TASK-20260923-b9fee8, which depends on every review (tools/research_dispatch.py _validate_review_chains). Every card sets fallback_allowed TRUE, with a reason. Review cards stay on review-adversarial at the policy's xhigh default, with degraded_allowed false and independent sessions required.
